What to find: How and why key design choices in training were made.
Card sections that often contain it: Training, Design

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Mid-fusion architecture combining the Phi-4-Reasoning backbone and SigLIP-2 vision encoder, chosen to leverage both pretrained components while keeping training and inference costs manageable. A dynamic resolution vision encoder (up to 3,600 visual tokens) enables high-resolution understanding for GUI grounding and document analysis. Bidirectional attention is applied only within images to improve spatial reasoning without the overfitting risks of broader bidirectional schemes. A single model handles both reasoning and non-reasoning modes rather than separate models.
quotes: This approach leverages the strengths of both pretrained components while keeping training and inference costs manageable.

The model employs a dynamic resolution vision encoder with up to 3,600 visual tokens, enabling high-resolution image understanding critical for tasks such as GUI grounding and fine-grained document analysis.
Bidirectional attention is applied within images (intra-image) to improve spatial reasoning without the overfitting risks observed with broader bidirectional schemes.

Rather than training separate models for each mode, the model operates as a single system that can invoke extended chain-of-thought reasoning (using `<think>...</think>` blocks) for tasks like mathematical and scientific reasoning, or default to direct inference (tagged with `<nothink>`) for perception-focused tasks such as captioning, object detection, and grounding.
